_comment_git_policy: Only 'git add', 'git status', and 'git diff' are auto-approved. Enumerated destructive git subcommands are denied outright. Any other git subcommand is intentionally left off both lists so it is NOT auto-approved and falls through to a manual permission prompt. Do not add a blanket 'Bash(git:*)' deny — deny takes precedence and would also block the allowed add/status/diff.
